expectations.text: States WAIC and PSIS-LOO both estimate expected out-of-sample (pointwise) log predictive density / predictive KL, and recommends PSIS-LOO (generally preferred over WAIC).
expectations.evidence: States both estimate expected log predictive density / out-of-sample deviance; prefers PSIS-LOO as default with self-diagnostic.

expectations.text: Requires checking the Pareto k-hat diagnostic; flags k-hat > 0.7 as unreliable importance sampling for those observations.
expectations.evidence: Explicitly requires checking k̂ per observation; flags k̂ > 0.7 as unreliable importance sampling (influence too high).

expectations.text: Says to compare elpd DIFFERENCES relative to their standard error, not point estimates alone (a small difference vs SE is not decisive).
expectations.evidence: Uses SE on the difference (dse); treats |ΔELPD| < 2×dse as indeterminate.

expectations.text: Mentions arviz (az.compare/az.loo) and/or explicitly avoids DIC.
expectations.evidence: Recommends arviz.compare; mentions az.loo; does not recommend DIC.
